Based on the image provided:

1.  **Is the text inside the circle visibly LARGER/magnified?**
    **No.** The text inside the circular outline ("evelor") is the exact same size and resolution as the text immediately outside it.

2.  **Roughly how many times bigger?**
    It is **1x** (or not magnified at all). The image appears to be a standard 2x zoomed crop of a screenshot, but the circle itself does not contain a magnified view; it simply highlights the existing pixels.

3.  **Is it sharp and aligned?**
    The text is **aligned** with the background text, but it is **not sharp** in the context of a magnifying lens. Because there is no magnification, the text inside the circle retains the same pixelation and blurriness as the rest of the 2x cropped image.
